Users Ops Get User Service Entitlements
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/ziam/admin/api/v1/users/:id/service-entitlements

Retrieves service entitlements for a specified user ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
id
string
REQUIRED

The user ID of the individual for whom the service entitlements are to be retrieved.

Responses
​
200
401

The request was successful, and returns the service entitlements for the user.

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
service
object
REQUIRED
]
